mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache Eviction Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache eviction policy with a fixed TTL of 300 seconds, chosen because LRU is easier to reason about and tune, and the fixed TTL gives cached entries a deterministic refresh interval.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
